prompt: What was the founding name of the company that ran the coal mining camp in the city where baseball great Willie Mays was born?
answer: The coal-mining camp was originally run by the **Tennessee Coal, Iron and Railroad Company**—usually called the **Tennessee Coal & Iron Company (TCI)**. It was later acquired by **U.S. Steel**.
